entities.name: Temmet
entities.description: A sixteen-year-old vizier of Oketra who supervised the Anointed and other viziers in Naktamun; later eternalized, killed, and revived by Ketramose.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: God of Amonkhet whom Temmet served as vizier; mother of Ketramose.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: God of Amonkhet who sought to undermine Oketra's authority over the anointed mummies.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The band of planeswalkers who stepped through the Hekma into Naktamun.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: A planeswalker of the Gatewatch whom Oketra recognized as one of her own.

entities.name: Jace
entities.description: A planeswalker who took control of Temmet's mind to escape.

entities.name: Liliana
entities.description: A planeswalker found with Jace in the embalming chambers.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: Killed Temmet again during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Basri Ket
entities.description: Planeswalker who sought Temmet's tomb to revive him as part of a plan to revive Oketra and heal Naktamun.

entities.name: Mahitab
entities.description: Basri's crop-mate who led the party to the pyramid.

entities.name: Niharet
entities.description: Basri's crop-mate who held a khopesh to his throat.

entities.name: Munhatep
entities.description: A Monarch who took Temmet's body in the name of the Chitin Court and the Scarab God.

entities.name: Ketramose
entities.description: The lion god, Oketra's child, who revived Temmet to serve him.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The city of Amonkhet protected by the Hekma.

entities.name: Hekma
entities.description: An invisible magic barrier protecting Naktamun.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: The Phyrexian-aligned undead army that invaded Ravnica.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The invasion of Ravnica during which Temmet fought as an Eternal.

events.summary: Temmet first meets the Gatewatch after they pass through the Hekma, leads them through Naktamun and takes them before Oketra.
events.quote: he agreed to lead them through the city and answered questions about their way of life

events.summary: Temmet finds Jace and Liliana in the embalming chambers; Jace takes control of his mind so they can flee.
events.quote: Jace took control of his mind, allowing the two planeswalkers to flee.
Sometime later, he was killed and eternalized .

events.summary: As an Eternal, Temmet joins the Dreadhorde invasion of Ravnica and is killed again by Samut.
events.quote: He was killed once more by Samut .

events.summary: Temmet's body is repatriated to Amonkhet and entombed in a pyramid in the Broken Lands.
events.quote: He was entombed in a sarcophagus and allowed to rest.

events.summary: Basri Ket offers Mahitab and Niharet money for the location of Temmet's tomb, hoping to revive him.
events.quote: Basri hoped to awaken the former vizier as part of a larger plan to revive Oketra and heal Naktamun.

events.summary: Munhatep interrupts the party at the pyramid, demands Temmet's body, and takes it.
events.quote: Munhatep removed Temmet's body and prepared to retreat

events.summary: Ketramose arrives, tosses Munhatep aside, and revives Temmet, declaring that he will serve Ketramose.
events.quote: The god proceeded to revive Temmet, freeing him from the charred lazotep

relations.quote: Though he was technically a vizier of Oketra

relations.note: Declared to serve Ketramose after revival.
relations.quote: declaring that Temmet would serve Ketramose as he had the god's mother, Oketra
He was killed once more by Samut .
as he had the god's mother, Oketra

relations.note: Bontu was the one god he did not consider an ally.
relations.quote: Bontu is the one god he did not consider an ally.
